name: WALLET_SIZING_SCOPE_V1
reason: Production budget is min(config.risk_fraction=.30,.10)=.10 of equity, while cost budget is .30*.10=.03 of equity. Effective allowed cost/planned-risk is .30. With2% wallet risk keep that same ratio: .02*.30=.006 of equity; not accidentally tighten it to .002.
execution_sizing: Confirm actual or contingent price lies inside ORIGINAL frozen band, then evaluate a singleton price interval for sizing/ranking in BOTH arms. Same per-unit costs,RR,contract and10x checks; actual risk capped at2% equity including costs. No change to production config.
funding_at_entry: Only settlements strictly before decision inform projected next6h funding; use actual events for realized flows. Never use future settlement rate for entry gating.
weekly_split: No signals in last4h of each of3weeks; all positions timeout by weekly boundary. Report each week reset100 plus continuous21day wallet without reset.
missing_valuation: If full Fair/funding cannot be loaded, keep explicitly approximate fallback results separate and do not approve profitability.
